title: Postdoctoral Researcher positions - Statistical Physics and Active Matter
institution: Max Planck Institute for Dynamics and Self-Organization (MPIDS), Department of Living Matter Physics
about: The Department of Living Matter Physics at MPIDS in Göttingen offers several two-year, full-time Postdoctoral Researcher positions in theoretical and computational nonequilibrium statistical physics and active matter (ref. MPIDS-W092), with flexible start. Processing begins after the 10 January 2027 deadline.
requirements: Prior experience with nonequilibrium statistical physics and strong interest in active matter physics
Good English (German an asset, not required)
